english.title: Speeding - exceed 30 mph on restricted road in England - manned equipment
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) drove a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a restricted road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), at a speed exceeding 30 miles per hour
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 81(1) and 89(1) of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
drive a motor vehicle
on a restricted road
speed exceeding 30 mph

english.notes: From 17th September 2023 and due to Article 2 of SI 2022/800 Restricted Roads (20 mph Speed Limit) (Wales) Order 2022 the rate of speed fixed by section 81(1) of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 is reduced to 20 miles per hour for Wales only. For the offences applying in Wales from the 17th September 2023, see H101065 (ACD) and H101066 (manned equipment). For the offences applying in England from this date, see H101390 (ACD).
